title: Step 20 global flux-energy identity

identities.v_flux_equals_rod_flux: On each rod, the outward flux of w*grad v equals the rod flux Phi_i
identities.stream_function: psi defined by d(psi) = *(w dv); psi constant on rods with jumps = Phi_i
identities.energy_of_psi: int |grad psi|^2 = int w^2 |grad v|^2 = 2 int w^2 + 4 int K_B w^2
identities.K_B_identity: int K_B w = int w (from the eigenvalue equation)

modulus_path: A conformal modulus lower bound for the alternating-rod polygon would give a rigorous BUILD theorem: if the modulus is bounded below uniformly in m, then total flux >= c > 0.
open: The conformal modulus of the m-gon with alternating Dirichlet BCs as m -> infinity must be computed or estimated.
